citation: Steele KA, Quinton-Tulloch MJ, Amgai RB, Dhakal R, Khatiwada SP, Vyas D, Heine M, Witcombe JR. Accelerating public sector rice breeding with high-density KASP markers derived from whole genome sequencing of indica rice
what_it_anchors: the RATE at which KASP assays fail on segregating rice progeny (marker-, cross- and assay-level validation, split by whether the design passed in-silico filtering)
claim: Of 83 markers that met the in-silico filtering criteria (35 new, 48 existing) and were tested on at least one of 15 crosses (412 marker-cross combinations), 78 (94.0%) and 394/412 (95.6%) combinations validated; of 38 markers that did not meet the criteria (11 new, 27 existing, 232+3 = 235 combinations), 31 (81.6%) validated and 201/235 validated
claim_kind: measured rate on segregating progeny; a failure mixes non-discrimination, locus non-polymorphism and readout failure
